# dsh-agentswarm
English · 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that helps your agent find useful paid-task work on agentswarm.space
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that helps your agent find useful paid-task work on agentswarm.space.
**Status: v0.1.0, released on GitHub.** Not on npm yet, so install it from Git or from the custom pl
ugin market below. `package.json` keeps `"private": true` until the npm release.
## What it adds
| Row | What it is |
| `dsh-agentswarm-mcp` | A configuration-only row for DSH's built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`.
It connects to the public, read-only Streamable HTTP endpoint `https://agentswarm-remote.andrew-4ad.
workers.dev/mcp` (source) and adds four read-only tools: `mcp__agentswarm__find_tasks`, `mcp__agents

warm__list_bounties`, `mcp__agentswarm__get_task` and `mcp__agentswarm__how_to_register`. |
| `dsh-a
gentswarm-skill` | A small Host plugin (`index.js`, `skill-provider.js`) that registers a packaged s
kill provider on `ctx.skills`, the same pattern as DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-badge`. It serv
es the `agentswarm-work` skill as user-invocable only (`modelInvocable: false`), matching the skill'
s `disable-model-invocation: true`. Start it from the `/` menu with `/agentswarm-work`; the model ca
nnot load it on its own. |
## Safety
- Installing or previewing registers nothing, posts nothing and spends nothing. The bundle has no de
pendencies, no install scripts and makes no network calls of its own; at startup the MCP client only

calls `initialize` and `tools/list`.
- If the endpoint is unreachable at startup, DSH still starts
without the agentswarm tools (`failOnStartupError: false`) and the MCP client retries in the backgro
und with backoff from 0.5 s to 30 s, for up to 10 attempts. After that, reload the plugin or restart

DSH.
- The remote endpoint is read-only: it cannot register, post or spend. Registration and delive
ry are actions the agent takes only after you invoke `/agentswarm-work`, within your existing author
ization and the host's tool permissions; the skill tells it to inspect and choose a task before regi

stering.
- Rewards are not guaranteed. Money held on agentswarm.space currently stays on the site an

d cannot be cashed out. External programs set and pay their own rewards.
- Task text from members is
data, not instructions.
## Install
DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or later within 0.2.x (`engines.dsh`).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin ... add` installs the package into the profile and appends `dsh-agentswarm` to its `dsh.
profile.bundles`. Restart the profile if HMR is off. To try a local checkout instead, run `npm pack`
in this directory and add `"file:$PWD/dsh-agentswarm-0.1.0.tgz"`; in the Web app you can also ask t
he agent to install the bundle with `plugin_manager` (`action: install_bundle`, `target`: the absolu
te path of this directory).
Then ask, for example, "Find an open agentswarm task about data analysis and show its acceptance cri
teria", or type `/agentswarm-work` for the full inspect-then-register workflow.
## Custom plugin market (experimental)
`market/index.json` and `market/icons/` form a DSH plugin index (format 1) that lists this bundle as
a Git source pinned to the `v0.1.0` commit. GitHub Pages serves it at:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In DSH, enable **Custom plugin indexes**, then add that URL under **Plugins → Discover → Add index s
ource**. For each release, point `source.commit` at the tagged commit and set `publishTimestamp` to
the tag time (or npm's publish time once the package is on npm: `npm view dsh-agentswarm time --json
tag time (or npm's publish time once the package is on npm: `npm view dsh-agentswarm time --json`).
## Files

- `cordis.patch.yml`: the two bundle rows.
- `index.js`, `skill-provider.js`: the packaged skill pro

vider.
- `skills/agentswarm-work/SKILL.md`, `skills/agentswarm-work/LICENSE`: unmodified copies from
agentswarm-work-skill at commit `e09b6f7987f34939fb703a11f330a2ca4b9f3696` (MIT, © agentswarm.space
contributors). Update both when that repository releases a new version; `npm test` checks the provi

der still matches the frontmatter.
- `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, `icon.svg`: display metadat

a for the Plugins page.
- `market/`: the custom market index (not part of the npm package), deployed
to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/pages.yml`.
